title: Swarm: re-activate a drained node
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add swarm --role worker --yes`. Finds the drained node and re-activates it (`docker node update --availability active` + re-promote if a manager + `nomad node eligibility -enable`).

observe.what: the drained node is re-activated into Swarm scheduling + Nomad eligibility

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync reverses the drain; growing the fixed 3+3 fleet is reported as a terraform operation, not silently skipped.
